Standard: 1.L.V.1
Domain primary: Vocabulary
Domain secondary: Speaking & Listening, Writing
Cognitive demand: DOK2_skills_concepts
Competency: Students acquire and use general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words and phrases in different settings.
Skills:
- Acquire general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words and phrases through grade-level texts and content.
- Use grade-level general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words and phrases to communicate in a variety of settings.
Observable behaviors:
- Identify and learn new vocabulary words from grade-level texts and content.
- Use vocabulary words appropriately when speaking and writing in various contexts.
Pedagogy terms: vocabulary acquisition, academic vocabulary, specialized vocabulary, word usage, communication
Required student actions:
- recognition_identification: Recognize and identify general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words in grade-level texts and content.
- oral_production: Use general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words correctly when speaking in different settings.
- written_production: Use general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words correctly when writing in different settings.
- procedural_application: Apply vocabulary knowledge to understand and communicate ideas in various contexts.
Codes: 1.L.V.1

Standard: 1.L.V.1.a
Domain primary: Vocabulary
Domain secondary: Language
Cognitive demand: DOK2_skills_concepts
Competency: Use general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words and phrases from grade-level texts and content.
Skills:
- Acquire general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words and phrases through grade-level texts and content.
- Apply general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words and phrases in appropriate contexts.
Observable behaviors:
- Identify and use vocabulary words from grade-level reading materials.
- Apply vocabulary words in speaking and writing related to grade-level content.
- Recognize academic and specialized words in context.
Pedagogy terms: vocabulary, academic vocabulary, specialized vocabulary, grade-level texts, word meaning
Required student actions:
- recognition_identification: Identify vocabulary words and phrases in grade-level texts and content.
- oral_production: Use vocabulary words and phrases appropriately in speaking.
- written_production: Use vocabulary words and phrases appropriately in writing.
- procedural_application: Apply vocabulary words and phrases in various grade-level contexts.
Codes: 1.L.V.1.a

Standard: 1.L.V.3
Domain primary: Vocabulary
Domain secondary: Language
Cognitive demand: DOK2_skills_concepts
Competency: Students make connections between words and phrases and use reference materials to determine or clarify word meanings in different situations and for various purposes.
Skills:
- Use context within and beyond a sentence to determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases.
- Identify the relationship between words and their synonyms and antonyms.
- Distinguish shades of meaning among verbs that describe the same general action.
- With teacher support, use a picture dictionary or digital resource to clarify the meaning of unknown words and phrases.
- Use knowledge of word relationships and learned vocabulary words and phrases when making word choices in speaking and writing.
Observable behaviors:
- Use context clues within and beyond sentences to figure out the meaning of unknown or multiple-meaning words and phrases.
- Identify synonyms and antonyms of words.
- Notice and explain subtle differences in meaning among verbs that describe similar actions.
- Use a picture dictionary or digital resource with teacher support to find meanings of unknown words and phrases.
- Apply knowledge of word relationships and vocabulary when choosing words in speaking and writing.
Pedagogy terms: context clues, synonyms, antonyms, shades of meaning, reference materials, picture dictionary, digital resources, word relationships, vocabulary usage
Required student actions:
- recognition_identification: Identify synonyms, antonyms, and multiple-meaning words using context clues.
- oral_production: Use learned vocabulary and word relationships when speaking.
- written_production: Use learned vocabulary and word relationships when writing.
- matching_sorting_sequencing: Distinguish and sort verbs by subtle differences in meaning.
- procedural_application: Use context clues and reference materials to determine or clarify word meanings.
- investigation_handson: Use a picture dictionary or digital resource with teacher support to find word meanings.
- reasoning_explanation: Explain the relationship between words and their synonyms and antonyms and the differences among similar verbs.
Codes: 1.L.V.3
candidates.label: Meaning & Purpose

candidates.text:
Standard: 1.P.EICC.3
Domain primary: Comprehension
Domain secondary: Vocabulary
Cognitive demand: DOK3_strategic_thinking
Competency: Students engage with complex texts for different purposes by using comprehension strategies before, during, and after reading to understand and make meaning.
Skills:
- Establish a purpose and set goals for reading
- Monitor comprehension and adjust strategies as needed
- Scan and skim the text to note useful structures and sections
- Draw from and integrate prior knowledge with the text, addressing inconsistencies or gaps
- Summarize and visualize sections of the text to maintain understanding
- Make and track predictions about upcoming events and information
- Make, track, and support inferences about different levels of meaning
- Determine meanings of unfamiliar words and concepts using context, academic vocabulary, and word parts
Observable behaviors:
- Set a purpose and goals for reading a text
- Monitor understanding while reading and adjust strategies as needed
- Scan and skim texts to identify useful structures and sections
- Connect prior knowledge to new information in the text and resolve inconsistencies
- Summarize and create mental images of text sections to maintain understanding
- Make and track predictions about upcoming events or information in the text
- Make, track, and support inferences about meanings within the text
- Determine meanings of unfamiliar words using context, academic vocabulary, and word parts
Pedagogy terms: comprehension strategies, monitor comprehension, set reading goals, scan and skim, prior knowledge, summarize, visualize, predict, infer, context clues, academic vocabulary, word parts
Required student actions:
- recognition_identification: Identify text structures and unfamiliar words using context and word parts
- procedural_application: Apply comprehension strategies such as setting goals, monitoring understanding, scanning, summarizing, predicting, and inferring while reading
- representation_modeling: Visualize and summarize sections of text to support understanding
- reasoning_explanation: Explain inferences and predictions about text meaning and events
- comprehension_response: Summarize text sections and track comprehension progress
Codes: 1.P.EICC.3
candidates.label: Comprehension Strategies

candidates.text:
Standard: 1.L.V.1.b
Domain primary: Vocabulary
Domain secondary: Language
Cognitive demand: DOK2_skills_concepts
Competency: Use grade-level general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words and phrases to communicate in different settings.
Skills:
- Use grade-level general vocabulary words and phrases to communicate.
- Use grade-level academic vocabulary words and phrases to communicate.
- Use grade-level specialized vocabulary words and phrases to communicate.
Observable behaviors:
- Use appropriate vocabulary words when speaking or writing for different purposes and audiences.
- Select words that fit the topic and situation in conversations and writing.
- Demonstrate understanding of word meanings by using them correctly in context.
Pedagogy terms: vocabulary, word meanings, academic vocabulary, specialized vocabulary, communication
Required student actions:
- recognition_identification: Recognize grade-level general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words and phrases in spoken and written language.
- oral_production: Use grade-level vocabulary words and phrases correctly when speaking in various settings.
- written_production: Use grade-level vocabulary words and phrases correctly when writing for different purposes.
- procedural_application: Apply knowledge of grade-level vocabulary to communicate effectively in different settings.
Codes: 1.L.V.1.b

Standard: 1.L.V.3.c
Domain primary: Vocabulary
Domain secondary: Language
Cognitive demand: DOK2_skills_concepts
Competency: Identify and explain subtle differences in meaning among verbs that describe similar actions.
Skills:
- Distinguish shades of meaning among verbs that describe the same general action.
Observable behaviors:
- Compare verbs that describe similar actions and notice differences in meaning.
- Explain how different verbs convey different shades of meaning for the same general action.
- Use examples like walk, march, strut, and prance to distinguish meanings.
Pedagogy terms: shades of meaning, verbs, word meanings, word comparison
Required student actions:
- recognition_identification: Recognize verbs that describe similar actions and identify differences in their meanings.
- oral_production: Use verbs with different shades of meaning in speaking to describe actions.
- matching_sorting_sequencing: Sort or group verbs based on their subtle differences in meaning.
- reasoning_explanation: Explain how verbs that describe the same general action differ in meaning.
- comprehension_response: Respond to questions about the differences in meaning among similar verbs.
Codes: 1.L.V.3.c

Standard: 1.P.EICC.2.d
Domain primary: Comprehension
Domain secondary: Writing, Speaking & Listening
Cognitive demand: DOK3_strategic_thinking
Competency: Interpret and create texts to help analyze and evaluate texts and ideas.
Skills:
- Interpret texts to analyze ideas.
- Construct texts to evaluate ideas.
Observable behaviors:
- Explain the meaning of texts in their own words.
- Create texts that express their understanding of ideas.
- Use texts to compare and think critically about ideas.
Pedagogy terms: interpretation, text construction, analysis, evaluation, ideas, author and audience
Required student actions:
- recognition_identification: Identify ideas and information in texts to support analysis and evaluation.
- oral_production: Explain interpretations and evaluations of texts orally.
- written_production: Create written texts that express analysis and evaluation of ideas.
- procedural_application: Use texts intentionally to analyze and evaluate ideas.
- representation_modeling: Construct texts that represent understanding of ideas.
- reasoning_explanation: Explain reasoning behind interpretations and evaluations of texts.
- comprehension_response: Respond to texts by interpreting and evaluating ideas.
Codes: 1.P.EICC.2.d

Standard: 1.P.EICC.2
Domain primary: Speaking & Listening
Domain secondary: Writing, Comprehension
Cognitive demand: DOK3_strategic_thinking
Competency: Engage in written or spoken conversations as both a speaker and listener for different tasks and purposes, making meaningful connections within and across texts and to real life.
Skills:
- Engage in spoken or written dialogue as an author and audience.
- Make intentional connections within texts.
- Make intentional connections between texts.
- Make intentional connections beyond texts to other knowledge or experiences.
Observable behaviors:
- Participate in dialogues by sharing ideas and responding to others.
- Make connections between different texts during discussions.
- Relate ideas from texts to personal experiences or other knowledge.
- Use spoken or written language intentionally to communicate for various purposes.
Pedagogy terms: dialogue, author and audience, text connections, purposeful communication
Required student actions:
- oral_production: Speak and respond in dialogues for different purposes.
- written_production: Write to communicate ideas and respond to texts.
- procedural_application: Use dialogue skills to connect ideas within and between texts.
- reasoning_explanation: Explain connections made between texts and ideas during dialogue.
- comprehension_response: Respond thoughtfully to texts and peers in spoken or written form.
Codes: 1.P.EICC.2
candidates.label: Engagement & Intention

candidates.text:
Standard: 1.P.CP.1.d
Domain primary: Speaking & Listening
Domain secondary: Comprehension, Writing
Cognitive demand: DOK3_strategic_thinking
Competency: Work together with others to talk about topics, ask and investigate questions, solve problems, and explore and create texts.
Skills:
- Work with others to discuss topics.
- Work with others to investigate questions.
- Work with others to solve problems.
- Work with others to explore and create texts.
Observable behaviors:
- Participate in group discussions about various topics.
- Ask and investigate questions collaboratively.
- Work with peers to solve problems.
- Explore and create texts together with others.
Pedagogy terms: collaboration, discussion, problem solving, text exploration, text creation
Required student actions:
- oral_production: Contribute ideas and questions during group discussions.
- procedural_application: Work cooperatively with others to discuss topics, investigate questions, solve problems, and create texts.
- investigation_handson: Engage in collaborative inquiry and problem solving with peers.
- reasoning_explanation: Explain ideas and reasoning during group work.
- comprehension_response: Respond to and build on others' ideas in discussions.
Codes: 1.P.CP.1.d

Standard: 1.T.RA.2
Domain primary: Comprehension
Domain secondary: Speaking & Listening
Cognitive demand: DOK2_skills_concepts
Competency: Use parts of texts to support ideas or answers and explore different sources of information to make connections on various topics.
Skills:
- Refer to parts of texts when supporting an idea, answer, or opinion.
- Explore various sources of information, including print, digital, and personal communication.
Observable behaviors:
- Point to or name parts of a text when explaining an idea or answer.
- Identify and use information from print, digital, and personal communication sources.
- Discuss connections made from exploring multiple sources on a topic.
Pedagogy terms: text evidence, sources, information exploration, connections
Required student actions:
- recognition_identification: Identify parts of texts that support ideas or answers.
- oral_production: Explain ideas or answers using parts of texts and discuss information from various sources.
- procedural_application: Use parts of texts to support ideas or answers and explore various sources of information.
- investigation_handson: Explore various sources of information including print, digital, and personal communication.
- reasoning_explanation: Refer to parts of texts to support ideas or answers and explain connections made from multiple sources.
- comprehension_response: Use text parts to address specific questions and integrate information from various sources to understand topics.
Codes: 1.T.RA.2
candidates.label: Curating Sources & Evidence
